method: Slot candidates come from the separate pinned comparison table. A word is included only if it occurs literally with a Devanagari-letter boundary in a selected traditional lexical/rule passage. Danda is punctuation. Ambiguous āha and veti matches are restricted to their lexical discussions. The generator reads neither expected words nor the comparison table.
